name: 05-slice-write
description: Partial commits. Lane A opens one grain and commits it four times at 270 / 540 / 810 / all of its 1080 slices, a second apart -- the writer closes the grain only when validSlices reaches totalSlices. Lane B polls the same grain with mxlFlowReaderGetGrainSliceNonBlocking; whether it sees the grain depends only on how many slices are valid at that moment.

A.note: the whole payload is written up front; only the declared slice count changes below
no valid_slices means totalSlices: this one closes the grain and drops the cached slot

B.note: same grain, same instant, twice the demand: expect MXL_ERR_OUT_OF_RANGE_TOO_EARLY
t~2700, after the 540 commit: the identical call now succeeds
t~4500, after the closing commit: the whole grain, stamp included
